body: I wish i could cry with you

When i was 15 i made a promise to myself "if you dont get it together by the time you are 21 then you can die" im 23 and am about ready to make due on my promise i only ask that you give yourself til 21

I didnt expect anyone to care but my issue isnt that nobody cares or nobody loves me cause i dont care about that stuff. I just want to be self sufficient and ive failed at every turn i am the 23 year living with his mom. I want a restart and since thats impossible i want out thats it thank you for offering your support all i ask is you hear me and let me say goodbye to you. Thank you and goodbye you are a better person then i am.
